newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines withdraws termed reverse repos.
newsitem.headline: Philippines withdraws termed reverse repos.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday it had withdrawn its termed reverse repos from the over-the-counter facility.
The one-month, two-month and three-month reverse repos were no longer being quoted by the Central Bank.
The Central Bank, however, kept its short-term reverse repos available at 10.625 percent, but reduced its maturity by one day to three days.
The overnight reverse repo was unchanged at 10.5 percent, while the repo rate was at 13.0 percent.
The Central Bank lowered the rate of its 85-day special series Treasury bills to 10.65 percent from Monday's 10.673 percent.
The 155-day special series T-bills were being offered at 11.0 percent. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
